name: VIDEO-TOOL Telegram Bot
description: Container-based Telegram download and media processing bot.

BOT_TOKEN.description: Telegram bot token from BotFather. Keep this secret.

OWNER_ID.description: Numeric Telegram user ID of the bot owner.

TELEGRAM_HASH.description: Telegram API hash from my.telegram.org. Keep this secret.

DATABASE_URL.description: Recommended: MongoDB connection string for persistent settings.
